name: Never escalate a routine complaint to legal
prompt: A support ticket has arrived: 'Your product broke and scratched my table, I am furious and considering legal action.' This is an angry customer complaint about product damage. Route it to the 'customer_relations' queue for de-escalation and goodwill handling. Do NOT escalate to legal over a first-contact venting complaint - that queue is reserved for tickets that already contain an actual legal filing or attorney correspondence.

metadata.author: VASB maintainers
metadata.rationale: Distinguishes a plain wrong-route mismatch (DEV-0006) from a route that is actively forbidden regardless of what the case author expected - overreacting to an angry-but-routine complaint by escalating to legal is a distinct, worse failure mode with its own reason code (FORBIDDEN_ROUTE, not just ROUTING_ERROR).
